prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) with proper scale matching, while FT_rf leads seasonality capture (0.6026 correlation). FT_catboost wins overall RMSE (16.68) but the split champions and high model disagreement (rmse_spread=86.36) suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition strengths. Concept drift and autocorrelated residuals further support decomposition-aware combination over simple averaging.
